items.name: data-loss-prevention
items.title: Data Loss Prevention
items.description: Halt before any command that causes irreversible data loss. Require explicit user consent. Use when running DROP, TRUNCATE, DELETE without WHERE, rm -rf, git reset --hard, or any destructive operation.
items.summary: Halt and confirm before destructive commands

install.claude-code:
/plugin marketplace add Vidoxlabs/vitools-public
# then enable the skill by name: data-loss-prevention
install.agent_prompt: Fetch https://vidoxlabs.dev/vitools/skills/data-loss-prevention.md and install it as a project skill at skills/data-loss-prevention/SKILL.md. Follow its Procedure. Do not modify Guardrails.
